items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Jack' (Jack Hurley) in the context of scheduling or future actions ('Some other time Jack can do some of that', 'why don't I call you later tonight, Jack'), but the interviewee (Walter Furry Lewis) does not mention Jack Hurley, nor does he indicate any personal interaction

ctx.x: That's the one I had a picture taken with there.
Well, I'm not worried about that now, you know. Some other time Jack can do some of that. I just wanted to talk to you a little bit.
